Learning games for 3 and 4 year olds

Little Learners discover the basics through play: naming shapes, matching colours, counting objects and telling big from small. Brainy reads every instruction aloud, so children who cannot read yet can play on their own, and big, friendly buttons make every game easy to tap on a phone or tablet.

Get started →

🛡️ No ads · No chat with strangers · Parents in control

What your child learns

  • Recognising shapes: circle, square, triangle, star and more
  • Naming and matching colours
  • Counting objects one by one
  • Comparing sizes: big and small
  • Memory and concentration with picture cards

Questions parents ask

Can a 3 year old play on their own?

Yes. Brainy reads every instruction aloud and the games rely on pictures, so young children can play independently while you follow their progress in the parents’ dashboard.

How long should my child play?

Short sessions work best at this age. Each game takes a few minutes, and the adventure map lets your child stop after any level and carry on later.

Ready to start the adventure?

Create your parent account in a minute. One account covers up to 4 children.
